title: The number $4/9$ is a non-jump for $3$-graphs
summary: We prove that $4/9$ is a non-jump for $3$-uniform hypergraphs. Our construction perturbs the $ABB$ pattern by inserting, inside the $B$-part, the union of a high-cogirth pair of Steiner triple systems. This goes below the barrier for non-jumps obtainable by Shaw's finite-pattern formulation of the Frankl--Rödl method introduced in 1984. All results employing this approach use patterns where one of the parts has complete shadow.
